text: BRL-0158 implements this audio half (its scope includes "hit dealt vs. hit taken confirmation"): cue keys `hit-dealt` and `hit-taken` (instead of hit-confirm/damage-taken) in `assets/catalogs/audio_profiles.ron`, produced by the combat audio producer (`src/client/audio/producers/combat.rs`) from `DamageApplied` relative to the controlled fighter, one per attack id with 4-tick spacing per kind and concurrency cap 6, with original generated clips. Reduced-effects muting of these sounds is not implemented there. When BRL-0174 starts, re-scope it to the healing-number half plus any hit-audio tuning from the BRL-0158 playtest.
